messages:
Hannah: Heads-up — staging promote is blocked. Staging e2e failing for auth-service: refresh token tests returning 401 since 10:03 UTC.

Luis: Can you paste the failing assert + headers? flaky or deterministic? :eyes: 

Hannah: ```
FAIL tests/e2e/test_refresh_cycle.py::test_refresh_rotation
E AssertionError: expected 200 but got 401
E Request POST /internal/auth/refresh body={\"refresh_token\":\"***\"}
E Response headers: {\"x-cache-status\":\"HIT\", \"x-cache-ttl\":\"-1\"}
```

Marta: x-cache-ttl -1 indicates the CI fixture cache returned an expired/stale payload. We merged a token format change this morning; if the fixture cache serves the old payload, the refresh fails.

Hannah: Re-ran the job with fixtures disabled `CI_FIXTURE_CACHE=0 ./ci/run-staging-e2e.sh` -> all green. With cache on it fails reproducibly in this canary.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused by failing check `staging-e2e` (job 6834568001). Auto-rollback: OFF.

Luis: Two quick mitigation paths for the release window: 1) pin to last-good image (sha256:ff334455) + manual promote and invalidate fixtures, or 2) revert the token-format change (slower). Which do we want?

Marta: Pin + eviction is fastest. I can run eviction: `ci/tools/invalidate-fixtures --svc=auth-service --env=staging --prefix=token_*` (est ~2-3m). Also create a follow-up ticket to fix TTL semantics.

Hannah: Oncall Luis — do you approve pin+manual promote? If yes I will prepare the release note entry.

Luis: Approve pin+promote. Steps I will perform now:
1) `deploybot promote --image=sha256:ff334455 --env=staging --manual`
2) run `ci/tools/invalidate-fixtures --svc=auth-service --env=staging`
3) `./ci/retry-job 6834568001`

ci-bot: Manual promote requested by Luis. Canary redeploy scheduled to image sha256:ff334455 (https://ci.internal/6834568001).

Hannah: Eviction ran; re-run of canary passed. Staging e2e all green.

Marta: Creating follow-up: RD-9991 "auth-service CI fixture cache TTL regression" assigned to Platform, priority P1 post-release. Attaching failing logs + x-cache-ttl evidence.

Luis: Adding release-notes entry: "auth-service pinned to last-known-good image due to CI fixture cache TTL regression; will unpin after TTL fix (see RD-9991)."

InfraBot: Suggestion: add a CI guard that fails builds when `x-cache-ttl` < 0 for fixture responses.

Marta: Will add the CI guard and a unit smoke to the fixture service. Also drafting an ops runbook snippet for manual eviction commands and expected timings.

Hannah: Thanks team — release window unblocked. :tada:

deploy-bot: Promotion completed. Manual promote by Luis applied. Release may proceed.
